Tejasvi Surya Replaced as BJYM Chief; New President Appointed

Tejasvi Surya has been removed from his position as the national president of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM), the youth wing of the BJP. Dr. Hemang Joshi has been appointed as the new national president. Surya expressed his emotions on X (formerly Twitter), reflecting on his 14-year journey with the organization. The BJP's new team, announced by national president Nitin Naveen, aims to strategize for upcoming state assembly and Lok Sabha elections. Other prominent figures like Anurag Thakur and Raghav Chadha were also not included in the new organizational structure.
